summary: Completed public-preview API and responsive portfolio E2E testing. Core load, navigation, inquiry submission, contact destinations, mobile menu, overflow, image loading, and console health passed. Copy-pitch feedback failed.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking COPY PITCH does not change the button to COPIED or show success feedback in the browser test.

integration_issues.flow: Project inquiry with no project type
integration_issues.issue: The select is not marked required and submitInquiry only checks name, email, and message, but the backend requires project_type; a blank project type reaches POST /api/inquiries and returns 422 with a generic failure toast.

action_items: Handle navigator.clipboard.writeText rejection or provide a fallback so the copy action reliably shows success feedback.
Make project type required in the UI and validate it before POST, or make the backend field optional consistently; show field-level feedback for the missing value.
critical_code_review_comments: copyPitch has no catch path: when clipboard permission/API fails, copied state and success toast never run.
Frontend and backend inquiry validation rules are inconsistent for project_type, causing avoidable 422 responses from a user-completable form.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST-prefixed inquiry through the public API and one E2E inquiry through the UI; inquiry endpoint has no public read/delete route for cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview tested at root on desktop and 390px mobile. Recheck clipboard success and blank project-type validation after fixes. No auth flow applies. No mocked APIs were used.
rca of the issue: Clipboard RCA: copyPitch awaits navigator.clipboard.writeText before setting copied=true; the preview browser did not complete that call, so the state update was skipped and no error handler surfaced. Inquiry RCA: InquiryCreate requires project_type while the select lacks required and submitInquiry omits project_type from its client-side required check.
